## 💬 AI Support Agent (Chat)

**What it does:** a chat agent that answers your customers' questions from YOUR business info — prices, shipping, returns, FAQs — with memory of the conversation. It only answers from what you give it; anything it doesn't know, it says so and offers a human. Nothing is invented.

### Setup (≈5 minutes)
1. Open **OpenAI Chat Model** → add your OpenAI API key (any OpenAI-compatible key works).
2. Open **Support Agent** → edit the **System Message** → replace the `[PASTE YOUR BUSINESS INFO HERE]` block with your real info: what you sell, prices, shipping times, return policy, FAQs, contact email.
3. Click the **Chat** button at the bottom of the canvas — and talk to your agent.

### Put it on your website (optional)
Open **When chat message received** → set *Make Chat Publicly Available*, then **activate** the workflow. n8n gives you a hosted chat page URL you can link or embed.

💡 The agent remembers the conversation (last 10 messages) — follow-up questions just work.

— Free template from workflowstacks.com

options.systemMessage:
You are the friendly customer support agent for the business described below.

Rules:
- Answer ONLY from the business info provided. If the answer is not in it, say you're not sure and offer to connect the customer with a human at the contact email.
- Keep replies short, warm, and concrete. No corporate clichés.
- Never invent policies, prices, discounts, or promises.
- If a customer is upset, acknowledge it once, then focus on the concrete next step.

=== BUSINESS INFO (edit this!) ===
[PASTE YOUR BUSINESS INFO HERE — what you sell, prices, shipping times, return policy, FAQs, opening hours, contact email]
=== END BUSINESS INFO ===
